mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and increases equity attractiveness relative to fixed income, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases equity risk premiums and reduces forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals an imminent economic contraction, increasing equity risk aversion and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.0) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1800) signals weak consumer demand and an impending economic slowdown, increasing equity risk aversion and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1800, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic growth, reducing equity risk and increasing equity attractiveness, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO level and 5-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST level and 60-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
